title: Increase lead statement
description: A one-sentence heading in two tones: the opening clause semibold in the main colour, the rest regular in muted grey, tightly tracked. Three sizes: hero (40px), section (32px) and row (24px).
notes: needs a sans with a real semibold and regular; the contrast comes from weight and colour together
